say.text: Shawar and all the Egyptians joined the Franks to give battle to Shirkuh. There were many skirmishes and many battles.
Ibn Khallikan's notes place the battle of al-Babain near Ushmunayn, in Middle Egypt. Ibn Shaddad's own account does not mention it.
After the battle, Salah ad-Din went to Alexandria, and fortified himself there.
The Franks and Shawar will not let me alone in the south. Alexandria is yours to hold. It has walls, and a harbour.
And if it does not wish to be held, uncle?
Then be its friend before you are its master. Hold it until I come.
And if you do not come?
Then I shall have been a poor uncle. I will come.
